newsitem.title: BELGIUM: FLEMISH VLAM-21 INDEX OUTPERFORMED BEL-20 - CORLUY.
newsitem.headline: FLEMISH VLAM-21 INDEX OUTPERFORMED BEL-20 - CORLUY.

text.p: The VLAM 21 index of leading Flemish bourse-listed companies has outperformed the Brussels bourse' Bel-20 index of leading Belgian companies, Antwerp brokerage Corluy & Cie said on Thursday.
From late 1991 until today the VLAM 21 has soared by 108.2 percent, while the Bel-20 index only rose by 62.1 percent, Corluy said.
The VLAM index was launched in June 1994. The 1991 figures have been recalculated retrospectively.
